title: Cluster P&O Partner - Bollaram API Sites
description:
Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
**Good Health Can’t Wait**
.

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

**Job Description**

**Business Priorities
:**
These priorities align HR efforts with the broader organizational strategy, enabling sustainable business outcomes.

1.
**Strategic Workforce Planning & Organizational Design**

* Translate business strategy into actionable people moves.
* Lead workforce planning and budgeting to optimize productivity.
* Design and implement organizational structures that support strategic goals and close process gaps.
* Drive people related Idea savings and Effort Hours reduction as per Lean Management Systems. Proactively partner with business to maintain headcount and Staff/Contract Labour Costs within budget. Achieve the targeted effort hours, head count and savings targets agreed at the beginning of the year.

2.
**Talent Strategy & Succession Planning**

* Develop and execute a forward-looking talent roadmap.
* Conduct talent reviews, competency assessments, and succession planning.
* Ensure timely, strategic hiring and build a diverse, future-ready talent pipeline.

3.
**Change Leadership & Transformation**

* Lead complex change initiatives (e.g., M&A, restructuring, new org integration).
* Drive transformation programs that align with business evolution.
* Support leaders and teams through change with structured interventions.

4.
**Culture & Engagement**

* Champion ASPIRE tenets and LEAN principles.
* Role model and embed desired behaviours across the organization.
* Design and implement engagement strategies to shape a high-performance culture.
* Drive Autonomous Way of working culture on the shopfloor and connect with the performance management systems.
* Drive the Speak-up culture and Quality transformation agenda across site.

5.
**Stakeholder Engagement & External Relations**

* Partner with business leaders to align HR with strategic needs.
* Manage employee relations and proactively address grievances.
* In close partnership with the legal team, represent the organization in external forums and ensure compliance with labour laws.

**Functional Priorities**
: These are core HR responsibilities that enable business success through operational excellence and people-centric processes.

1.
**Talent Development & Capability Building**

* Have a clear Succession plan and pipeline into Site Leadership Team (SLT) and SLT-1 roles.
* Identify capability gaps and partner with L&D and TTO teams to build critical skills.
* Support individual development planning and career growth.
* Promote a learning culture aligned with business priorities (e.g., Leadership, LTO, Product Robustness, Process Robustness, Asset Robustness and People Robustness capabilities).
* Apply Buy, Build and Transfer strategy to drive Capability.

2.
**Performance & Rewards**

* Lead the performance management cycle with a focus on continuous feedback and accountability.
* In close partnership with C&B CoE, implement compensation and benefits strategies that attract, retain, and motivate talent.
* Ensure governance and fairness in performance and rewards processes.
* Identify top performers and bottom performers early on and implement interventions accordingly.

3.
**HR Process Excellence & Service Delivery**

* Continuously improve HR processes across the employee lifecycle in close partnership with HR shared services.
* Guide HR Partners on escalations, compliance, and policy interpretation.
* Leverage internal and external expertise to co-create solutions aligned with business needs.

4.
**Recruitment, Onboarding & Employee Experience**

* Work in close partnership with Recruitment CoE to drive timely closure and on time joining for budgeted head count and ensure 100% staffing in Must Win Products and Products that Matter lines.
* Deliver a seamless onboarding experience that accelerates integration and productivity.
* Enhance employee experience through consistent, high-quality HR touchpoints.

5.
**HR Analytics & Insights**

* Generate actionable insights through HR analytics and reporting received through Shared Services or SpadeX teams.
* Use data to inform retention strategies and address workforce challenges.

6.
**Employee and Industrial Relations**

* Develop and execute Industrial Relations strategy aligned to business objectives, ensuring strong ER/IR governance across operating sites.
* Build proactive IR risk intelligence through deep understanding of labour laws, union dynamics, and workforce sentiment; guide site HR and leaders.
* Drive positive employee relations, collective bargaining, and timely resolution of disputes to sustain industrial harmony.
* Assess and manage IR impact of organizational changes and transformations, enabling smooth transitions and employee confidence.
* Strengthen stakeholder relationships (government, community, contractors, local authorities) to protect compliance, continuity, and social license to operate.

**Qualifications**

MBA/Master degree/PG in Human Resources with atleast 10-12 years of experience (including managing a manufacturing site independently).

**Additional Information**

* Critical to have experience of transformation
* Hands-on experience in handling HR processes in a Manufacturing site & Industrial Relations
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.

title: Assoc. Dir Total Rewards APAC
description:
**Description**
Assoc. Dir Total Rewards APAC
  
  
Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  
  
Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  
  
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  
  
Why Syneos Health
  
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

**Job Responsibilities**
**Strategy & Leadership**

* Partner with Global Total Rewards leadership to develop and execute Total Rewards strategy across APAC.
* Provide APAC market insights, trends, and recommendations to influence global program design and local implementation.
* Identify opportunities to improve employee experience, efficiency, program effectiveness, and business alignment.
* Lead regional planning, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and execution across APAC.

**Benefits & Wellbeing**

* Oversee APAC benefits strategy, governance, administration, and delivery aligned with the global Total Rewards philosophy.
* Lead annual renewals, vendor and broker management, and benefits implementation planning.
* Ensure programs comply with local regulatory requirements and are appropriately documented, governed, and communicated.
* Evaluate benefit competitiveness, employee needs, and market practices; recommend enhancements aligned with company philosophy and financial objectives.
* Support wellbeing, recognition, engagement initiatives, and related APAC communications.

**Compensation Support**

* Partner with Global Compensation on regional initiatives, including annual compensation cycles, market reviews, salary structures, and selected projects.
* Support job architecture and career framework activities by providing regional insights, local market perspective, and implementation support.
* Provide regional and India-specific insights on labor market trends, competitive positioning, salary structures, compensation components, CTC design, allowances, benefits, statutory considerations, and employee impact.
* Partner with Compensation, HR, Finance, Payroll, Legal, and regional teams to support consistent, compliant execution of Total Rewards programs.

**Governance & Financial Management**

* Manage regional benefits budgets, vendor spend, and financial planning inputs with Finance, Procurement, and global Total Rewards leadership.
* Ensure appropriate governance, controls, documentation, and decision-making processes are in place for regional Total Rewards programs.
* Develop recommendations, business cases, and decision materials for senior leadership review.
* Support committee materials, executive reporting, and monitoring of program outcomes, risks, costs, and opportunities.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and develop the APAC Total Rewards team, including the APAC Total Rewards Manager and assigned Benefits/Rewards Analysts.
* Set clear priorities, expectations, development plans, operating rhythms, and accountability for high-quality delivery.
* Build organizational capability, succession strength, and team effectiveness within the region.

**Key Capabilities**

* Operates with initiative, urgency, and ownership of outcomes.
* Stays curious and seeks new tools and ways of working.
* Strategic thinker with strong execution discipline
* Strong financial and analytical skills
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders in a complex, matrixed environment
* Strong change management capabilities across multiple countries and stakeholders
* Thinks systematically, connecting strategy, operations, and stakeholder dynamics.
* Ability to balance global consistency with local market requirements

**Qualification Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or related field.
* 8+ years of Total Rewards, compensation, benefits, or HR rewards experience, including APAC program leadership and people or matrix leadership.
* Strong understanding of benefits, wellbeing, recognition, compensation, market benchmarking, and Total Rewards governance.
* Demonstrated experience with vendor management, annual renewals, regional program administration, budget management, and financial stewardship.
* Deep India Total Rewards expertise required, including salary structure design, compensation components, benefits administration, statutory and market allowances, cash and non-cash rewards, and the financial, compliance, and employee experience implications of structure changes.

**Get to know Syneos Health**
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
  
  
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
  
  
http://www.syneoshealth.com
  
  
**Additional Information**
Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.
  
  
**Summary**
The Associate Director, Total Rewards leads the design, governance, implementation, and management of Total Rewards programs across APAC as a key member of the Global Total Rewards Center of Excellence. The role provides strategic leadership for benefits, wellbeing, recognition, and selected compensation initiatives, with emphasis on India rewards expertise, including salary structures, statutory and market allowances, benefits design, and local regulatory requirements. Programs must support business objectives, employee experience, market competitiveness, compliance, and financial stewardship. This role serves as the regional Total Rewards leader for APAC and the primary link between global strategy and local execution, partnering with Total Rewards, HR, Finance, Legal, vendors, and business leaders to deliver consistent, effective, and locally relevant programs. The role is accountable for regional strategy, governance, program recommendations, budget ownership, vendor oversight, executive materials, and team leadership, while partnering with the APAC Total Rewards Manager on execution, reporting, analytics, budget tracking, and delivery support.

title: Global Benefits Senior Specialist
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The Global Benefits Specialist position is integral role to Milestone’s Global Benefits team. As the Global Benefits Specialist, you will serve as a primary point on various global benefit programs involving: leave of absence, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability plans, tax-preferred accounts, retirements plans, workplace accident benefits, and more within the guidelines of applicable laws and regulations. This position is responsible for providing a high-level of team member customer service, ensuring accurate and timely program administration, evaluating and recommending process improvements, and developing and delivering necessary benefit-related training for internal and external business partners.
  
  
**Essential Functions**
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  

* Plans, develops, and presents recommendations for competitive employee benefits programs to include medical, dental, vision, life & AD&D insurance plans, wellness, retirement plans, retiree insurance plans, etc. Evaluates and monitors benefits trends and makes recommendations
* Oversees the administration and support of benefits programs. Maintains plan documents. Ensures compliance with applicable benefits and tax legislation. Develops and maintains administrative procedures
* Assist and support employee enrollment, end to end setup of new benefit plans and/or benefit plan changes to include ADP and enrollment portal configuration, audits, updates to existing reports and analysis of the impact on benefit integrations and payroll.
* Partners with other departments (Finance, HRIS, Payroll, IT, etc.) as well as external vendors. In particular focus on interfaces and process improvements across departments.
* Ensures consistency in plan administration and regulatory compliance, including Partner with 3rd party benefits administrator for preparation and delivery statutory and other related compliance reporting.
* Assists in the development and implementation of employee communication and training programs relating to benefits programs and procedures.
* Provides review, technical analysis, and consultation related to all vendor relationships and activities, including ongoing meetings, reporting, and program updates or changes.
* Disseminates information to Milestone managers and internal staff regarding medical and other benefit claims management. Identifies opportunities of improvement resulting in positive impacts to existing plan design offerings.
* Partners with the Milestone HR manager in communicating benefit program trends, outcomes, return on investment, and targeted improvement solutions leadership. Prepares agendas and meeting materials.
* Develops and reports on benefit metrics. Leverage data from HRIS, vendors and brokers to create analytics to make data-driven strategy decisions.
* Create and update applicable presentations, plans and processes.
* Contribute to the improvement of departmental procedural workflow processes of using continuous improvement methodologies, which include: eligibility and enrollment processes, vendor performance monitoring, team member communications, notices and benefit delivery problem resolution.
* Audits carrier exception reports and reconciles benefits accounts and the billing process
* Acts as a point of contact for escalations pertaining to complex benefit matters
* Oversees data gathering and research on moderate to complex assignments and projects.

**Competencies And Qualifications**

* Quality/Compliance: Achieving a standard of excellence with work processes and outcomes, honoring Milestone policies and all regulatory requirements
* Customer Focus/Going Above and Beyond: Striving for high customer satisfaction, going out of way to be helpful and pleasant, making it as easy as possible for the customer even if the customer is within the department
* Open, Honest and Respectful Communication: Balancing listening and talking, speaking and writing, clearly, professionally, and accurately, influencing others, keeping others informed
* Collegiality/Collaboration: Being respectful, approachable and team oriented, building strong working relationships and a positive work environment. All hands-on deck approach - offering assistance to team members even if busy with own work and if asked to help, readily agrees even if will delay own work. If conflicting priorities, consult with manager
* Ability to manage/lead a unit project and programs;
* Ability to set program goals and manage timeliness; ability to prioritize work effectively;
* Ability to analyze financial data and prepare financial reports;
* Ability to educate and train internal and external customers;
* Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing; articulate,
* Must be detail-oriented, self-motivated, and self-managed to meet deadlines.
* Strong analytical, problem solving skills and project management expertise is required.
* Must be self-directed with the ability to work autonomously on several projects concurrently.

**Required Education And Experience**

* 5+ years of professional employee benefits experience with strong knowledge of plan design, automation, administration and compliance for retirement and health and welfare programs along with other employee benefit related laws and regulations is required.
* Progressively responsible experience in direct design, complex data analysis, implementation, and administration of benefits programs.
* Working knowledge of HRIS Benefit systems
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products, with advanced knowledge of Excel is required.

Travel
  
  
Occasionally to local offices as needed.
  
  
EEO Statement
  
  
Milestone Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This company does not and will not discriminate in employment and personnel practices on the basis of race, sex, age, handicap, religion, national origin or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. One company, endless possibilities.
  
  
Other Duties
  
  
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
  
  
**Compensation**

title: HCM Product Expert
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with Global P\&O, Total Rewards, and business stakeholders to understand compensation requirements and translate them into scalable and sustainable Workday solutions.
* Configure, maintain, and optimize Workday Advanced Compensation capabilities, including:
+ Merit Planning
+ Bonus Planning
+ Stock and Long\-Term Incentive Programs
+ Compensation Review Statements
+ Compensation Guidelines and Eligibility Rules

* Support, maintain, and enhance Workday Core Compensation configurations, business processes, and workflows. Serve as the product expert for compensation\-related functionality, providing guidance on Workday capabilities, best practices, and future enhancements.
* Configure and maintain Workday security roles and access controls to ensure the protection of sensitive compensation data and compliance with organizational policies.
* Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, calculated fields, and analytics to support compensation planning, decision\-making, and operational reporting. Lead requirements gathering sessions, facilitate stakeholder workshops, and perform impact assessments for new business initiatives and enhancement requests.
* Coordinate and execute testing activities, including test strategy development, test script creation, defect management, regression testing, and user acceptance testing. Create and maintain functional documentation, process maps, knowledge articles, training materials, and support documentation.
* Deliver end\-user training and provide operational support during annual compensation and reward cycles. Collaborate with integration, reporting, and technical teams to deliver seamless end\-to\-end HCM solutions.
* Evaluate Workday releases and feature updates to identify opportunities for process optimization and enhanced business value. Contribute to product roadmap planning and continuous improvement initiatives across the broader HCM product portfolio.


**Essential Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Strong experience configuring and supporting Workday Core Compensation, including compensation\-related business processes and workflows.
* Working knowledge of Business Processes and Advanced Compensation
* Working knowledge of Workday Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), including experience supporting data loads, mass data updates, and inbound and outbound data integrations.
* Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements and facilitating stakeholder workshops.
* Experience supporting testing activities, including defect resolution, solution validation, and user acceptance testing.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills with the ability to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to lead workstreams, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams. Proven stakeholder management experience within a global and matrixed environment.


**Desirable Requirements**
* Workday Compensation Certification.
* Experience supporting global compensation planning cycles and annual reward processes.
* Experience developing and maintaining Workday Reports, Calculated Fields, and Dashboards.
* Exposure to Agile product delivery methodologies and ways of working.
* Experience working within a global pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences organization.
* Understanding of broader Workday HCM processes, architecture, and downstream integrations.
* Experience contributing to continuous improvement initiatives and product enhancement roadmaps.


 Why Sandoz?
   

  

 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

 Join us!
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.
